hints.content: The hanger has equal weight on each side. Let's start by writing an expression for the weight on each side.

The left side of the hanger has $5$ weights, each of which weighs $\redD{u}$ units.  

The left side of the hanger weighs $5\times \redD{u}$ units, which we can simplify to $5\redD{u}$ units.

The right side of the hanger has one weight which weighs $60$ units.

So, the hanger shows us $5\redD{u}=60$.

The weight labeled $\redD{u}$ weighs $\dfrac{1}{5}$ as much as the $60$ unit weight.

$\redD{u}=\dfrac{60}{5}=?$
